text:
Maya R.: kicking off a config-only shove to help midday tail spikes with a shard-aware spreader. change-id cfg-2026-06-19-1. no model artifacts. planned canary=3% for 90m. keys: routing.mode=shard_aware_smooth, batch.window_ms=22->12, tenant_rate_factor=0.97, token_timeout_ms=30000->30500. DeployBot: queued config-only change cfg-2026-06-19-1 (canary=3%, window=90m) by Maya R.. monitor: https://console.redwood/change/cfg-2026-06-19-1 OpsBot: canary started at 1768923456. streaming -> https://ops.redwood/dash/cfg-2026-06-19-1
Noah: after ~9m I see p95 up ~14% on a subset of canary hosts; batch p50 down from 3 to ~1.7. sample snippet: ```batching.hist p50=3 -> 1.7; p95_latency_ms=195 -> 223``` Irene: smaller window is reducing multi-request coalescing; expect slight cost delta. suggest pinning top 5 tenants to previous config for now to shrink blast radius. Maya R.: ok pin big-alpha, big-beta, ecommerce-1, ads-main, search-core -> cfg-prev. DeployBot: pins applied (cfg-2026-06-19-pins): big-alpha,big-beta,ecommerce-1,ads-main,search-core -> cfg-prev
Ravi: add an auto-rollback: trigger if errors > 0.65% OR sustained p95 increase > 28% for 8m. attach to canary. DeployBot: rollback policy attached to cfg-2026-06-19-1: errors>0.65% OR p95_delta>28% for 8m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK
Noah: after pins, pinned tenants stable; canary cohort p95 delta now ~10%, errors 0.04%. recommend shrinking canary to 1.5% and extend to full 2h to validate under different loads. Maya R.: agree to shrink to 1.5%/120m. also adding a short release note in change doc with exact keys changed and pin list. DeployBot: canary adjusted to 1.5% and window extended to 120m (action by Maya R.). change doc updated: "routing.mode shard_aware_smooth; batch.window_ms 22->12; tenant_rate_factor 0.97; token_timeout_ms 30000->30500; pinned big-alpha,big-beta,ecommerce-1,ads-main,search-core; rollback: errors>0.65% OR p95_delta>28% for 8m; canary 1.5%/120m"
Irene: please also add expected cost note: "minor per-token cost increase due to reduced batching; projected +3-6% on high-QPS tenants". Maya R.: added. OpsBot: alert rule created: page if errors>2x baseline OR sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m -> https://ops.redwood/alerts/8129
Ravi: runbook for immediate rollback in change doc: ```1) POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-06-19-1"}' 2) verify pins: GET /config/pins -> ensure pinned tenants remain on cfg-prev 3) notify #eng-sre and #product 4) monitor key metrics for 30m 5) open incident if errors>1% for 10m``` Maya R.: reminder: hold off on any other routing/QoS merges until this window closes. if auto-rollback fires or anyone sees >0.5% errors, execute manual rollback and escalate. OpsBot: canary at 1.5% stable after 20m: p95_delta ~9%, errors 0.02%. next status update in 30m. Maya R.: thanks team  if there's anything odd, call immediate rollback. reconvene at end of observation to decide next morning ramp. :white_check_mark:
